source_refs.use: Implementation reference for repertoires, descriptors, and metrics.

limitations: Lifecycle metrics use synthetic switchboard policy simulations.
Readability is still proxy-scored until manual ratings are collected.
Descriptor cardinalities are hand-set and need calibration.

The lifecycle probe stresses each candidate with a morphology-derived load, but the stage-0 switchboard sim is bistable: a candidate either stabilizes (full survival) or enters a terminal stress spiral lasting ~12-14 ticks, so the lifecycle_survival axis reaches only 2 of its 5 bins. Intermediate survival bins await a harsher lifecycle model.
mutation_stability is cap-normalized (share of the SLIP mutation budget used); raw mean rates cannot leave the top bin under profile caps.
